scope: Whole archived guide and pinned HTML; source interpretation, not human/server verification

1.original_instruction: Find Shuda in Ayothaya (ayothaya 233 105), she's sad because her bridegroom is lost, you must help her find the ring that her bridegroom dropped in the sea.
1.short_ru: Поговорите с Shuda в ayothaya 233 105 о потерянном кольце.
1.short_en: Talk to Shuda at ayothaya 233 105 about the lost ring.
1.full_ru: Найдите Shuda в Ayothaya (ayothaya 233 105). Она переживает из-за пропавшего жениха. Помогите ей найти кольцо, которое он уронил в море.
1.full_en: Find Shuda in Ayothaya (ayothaya 233 105), she's sad because her bridegroom is lost, you must help her find the ring that her bridegroom dropped in the sea.

2.original_instruction: Walk right a bit, and you'll see a man who can rent you a fishing tool for finding the ring in the sea for 50z (you need 1 Monster Feed per try when fishing).
2.short_ru: Арендуйте инструмент за 50z; тратьте по 1 Monster Feed на попытку.
2.short_en: Rent the tool for 50z; spend 1 Monster Feed per attempt.
2.full_ru: Пройдите немного вправо: man сдаёт рыболовный инструмент для поиска кольца в море за 50z. На каждую попытку рыбалки требуется 1 Monster Feed.
2.full_en: Walk right a bit, and you'll see a man who can rent you a fishing tool for finding the ring in the sea for 50z (you need 1 Monster Feed per try when fishing).

items.condition: Per fishing attempt; unknown number of attempts, not a one-item quest total.

requirements.condition: Tool rental price, not asserted to repeat on every fishing attempt.

actions.condition: Repeat until the ring is found.

3.original_instruction: Try it until you find the Engagement Ring , and then go back to Shuda. She'll ask you to find her bridegroom (Anon).
3.short_ru: Найдите Engagement Ring и вернитесь к Shuda.
3.short_en: Find Engagement Ring and return to Shuda.
3.full_ru: Продолжайте попытки, пока не найдёте Engagement Ring. Затем вернитесь к Shuda: она попросит найти её жениха Anon.
3.full_en: Try it until you find the Engagement Ring , and then go back to Shuda. She'll ask you to find her bridegroom (Anon).

items.condition: Found through fishing; no explicit removal on return to Shuda.

4.original_instruction: You can find clue about where Anon is from an old man (ayothaya 193 171). He'll tell you that Anon has gone to the Ayothaya Dungeon. Note: You need to have fully completed the Ayothaya Dungeon Entrance Quest to continue (including retrieval of the Old Blue Box).
4.short_ru: Расспросите old man в ayothaya 193 171; полностью завершите Ayothaya Dungeon Entrance Quest, включая Old Blue Box.
4.short_en: Question the old man at ayothaya 193 171; fully finish Ayothaya Dungeon Entrance Quest, including Old Blue Box.
4.full_ru: Расспросите old man (ayothaya 193 171) о Anon. Он расскажет, что Anon отправился в Ayothaya Dungeon. Примечание: для продолжения нужно полностью завершить Ayothaya Dungeon Entrance Quest, включая получение Old Blue Box.
4.full_en: You can find clue about where Anon is from an old man (ayothaya 193 171). He'll tell you that Anon has gone to the Ayothaya Dungeon. Note: You need to have fully completed the Ayothaya Dungeon Entrance Quest to continue (including retrieval of the Old Blue Box).

items.condition: Receipt is the prerequisite completion milestone, not a second Footprint reward or item to consume.

requirements.condition: Full Ayothaya Dungeon Entrance completion including box receipt, not merely earlier access.

5.original_instruction: Now you must find 9 of Anon's footprints in Ayothaya Dungeon.
5.short_ru: Найдите 9 следов Anon в Ayothaya Dungeon.
5.short_en: Find 9 Anon footprints in Ayothaya Dungeon.
5.full_ru: Найдите 9 следов Anon в Ayothaya Dungeon.
5.full_en: Now you must find 9 of Anon's footprints in Ayothaya Dungeon.

requirements.condition: Combined count across both dungeon floors, not nine per floor.

6.original_instruction: There are four footprint spots (when you pass it, a dialog box will appear) in Ayothaya Dungeon Level 1, and five footprints in Ayothaya Dungeon Level 2. Level 1 Footprints: | ( ayo_dun01 256,61) | ( ayo_dun01 73,142) | ( ayo_dun01 243,257) | ( ayo_dun01 18,258) Level 2 Footprints: | ( ayo_dun02 146,117) | ( ayo_dun02 136,169) - Obtain Random Potions | ( ayo_dun02 73,213) | ( ayo_dun02 87,254) | ( ayo_dun02 89,262)
6.short_ru: Найдите четыре следа в ayo_dun01 и пять в ayo_dun02.
6.short_en: Find four footprints in ayo_dun01 and five in ayo_dun02.
6.full_ru: В Ayothaya Dungeon Level 1 находятся четыре точки со следами, а в Ayothaya Dungeon Level 2 — пять. При приближении появляется диалог. Точки Level 1: (ayo_dun01 256,61), (ayo_dun01 73,142), (ayo_dun01 243,257), (ayo_dun01 18,258). Точки Level 2: (ayo_dun02 146,117), (ayo_dun02 136,169) — получение Random Potions, (ayo_dun02 73,213), (ayo_dun02 87,254), (ayo_dun02 89,262).
6.full_en: There are four footprint spots (when you pass it, a dialog box will appear) in Ayothaya Dungeon Level 1, and five footprints in Ayothaya Dungeon Level 2. Level 1 Footprints: | ( ayo_dun01 256,61) | ( ayo_dun01 73,142) | ( ayo_dun01 243,257) | ( ayo_dun01 18,258) Level 2 Footprints: | ( ayo_dun02 146,117) | ( ayo_dun02 136,169) - Obtain Random Potions | ( ayo_dun02 73,213) | ( ayo_dun02 87,254) | ( ayo_dun02 89,262)

requirements.condition: Four on the first floor; list order is not asserted mandatory.
Five on the second floor; list order is not asserted mandatory.

rewards.condition: Random potion category from the stage-6 trigger at ayo_dun02 136,169; not ten of every potion and not another final reward.

7.original_instruction: When you find the last footprint, you need to stand exactly on tile (ayo_dun02 91,262) and shatter the bush to find Annon, or else you won't find him. Tell him that you're not Shuda and bring a White Potion to treat his wounds. 7.short_ru: После следов встаньте в ayo_dun02 91,262, разбейте куст и принесите White Potion для Annon.
7.short_en: After the footprints, stand at ayo_dun02 91,262, break the bush and bring White Potion for Annon.
7.full_ru: Найдя последний след, встаньте точно на клетку (ayo_dun02 91,262) и разбейте куст, чтобы обнаружить Annon; иначе вы его не найдёте. Скажите, что вы не Shuda, и принесите White Potion для лечения ран. Он даст опыт. reviews.detail: 50 Zeny is a fishing-tool rental price; only one Monster Feed is per attempt. Number of attempts and ring-removal behavior are not given. Holy/Holier Threads quantities are unspecified and they are not consumed.

Nine footprint points comprise four first-floor and five second-floor points. Final footprint at 89,262 and exact rescue tile 91,262 are distinct. No compulsory visit order is inferred from list order.

Anon/Annon refer to the same bridegroom in this guide; source spelling remains unchanged per step. Ten Random Potions are a category reward at the footprint trigger; final EXP selects one of nine level bands. Old Blue Box belongs to prerequisite completion, not another Footprint payout.
